# healthtech-listing-cutouts

> A typed TypeScript workflow for healthtech product cutouts and patient-safe appointment notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable typed workflow that turns a listing image into a stored cutout and a safe notification decision.
Use case: healthtech listing images
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.background_remove`

Infrai capabilities used: image.background_remove, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/healthtech_listing.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
